shortDescription: Manages firewall rules on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the firewall rule is related to.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: cidrs
options.description: List of CIDRs (full notation) to be used for firewall rule. Since version 2.5, it is a list of CIDR.

options.name: dest_cidrs
options.description: List of destination CIDRs (full notation) to forward traffic to if I(type=egress).

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the firewall rule is related to.

options.name: end_port
options.description: End port for this rule. Considered if I(protocol=tcp) or I(protocol=udp). If not specified, equal I(start_port).

options.name: icmp_code
options.description: Error code for this icmp message. Considered if I(protocol=icmp).

options.name: icmp_type
options.description: Type of the icmp message being sent. Considered if I(protocol=icmp).

options.name: ip_address
options.description: Public IP address the ingress rule is assigned to. Required if I(type=ingress).

options.name: network
options.description: Network the egress rule is related to. Required if I(type=egress).

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the firewall rule is related to.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol of the firewall rule. C(all) is only available if I(type=egress).

options.name: start_port
options.description: Start port for this rule. Considered if I(protocol=tcp) or I(protocol=udp).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the firewall rule.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of dictionaries having keys I(key) and I(value). To delete all tags, set an empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the firewall rule.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone in which the virtual machine is in.
